items.description: Payload for creating a new inventory item.

unitPrice.description: A pair of prices for the same amount under dual pricing: what the customer pays with cash and what they pay with card. When dual pricing is disabled both values are equal.

cash.description: Price paid with cash, in the smallest currency unit (e.g. cents).

card.description: Price paid with card, in the smallest currency unit (e.g. cents).

unitPrice.title: PricePair

priceType.description: How the item is priced: FIXED (catalog price), VARIABLE (price entered at sale time) or PER_UNIT (price per unit of measure, e.g. per pound).

unitType.description: Unit of measure for PER_UNIT items; null for other price types.

oneOf.description: Unit of measure for items sold per unit (priceType PER_UNIT). The 'value' discriminator is one of 'Kg', 'Lb', 'Oz' or 'Custom'; for 'Custom' the 'name' field carries the merchant-defined unit label.

name.description: Display name of the unit. Equals the discriminator for built-in units ('Kg', 'Lb', 'Oz'); a merchant-defined label for 'Custom' units.

oneOf.title: UnitType

name.description: Display name of the unit. Equals the discriminator for built-in units ('Kg', 'Lb', 'Oz'); a merchant-defined label for 'Custom' units.

isEBT.description: Whether the item is eligible for EBT (Electronic Benefit Transfer) payment.

categories.description: UUIDs of existing categories the item belongs to.

charges.description: UUIDs of existing charges (extra fees) applied to the item.

isChargesDefault.description: Whether the merchant's default charges are applied to the item in addition to the explicitly listed ones.

productCode.description: Product code of the item (e.g. UPC/barcode value).

itemCost.description: The merchant's cost for one unit of the item, in the smallest currency unit (e.g. cents).

quantity.description: Deprecated integer stock counter. Use stockQuantity instead.

stockQuantity.description: Initial stock quantity. Supports fractional values for per-unit items (e.g. 2.5 lb).

trackInventory.description: Whether CorePOS tracks stock for this item and decrements it on each sale.

dualPricingBasePriceType.description: Which side of the price pair (CASH or CARD) is the base price; the other side is derived from the dual-pricing rate.

createdAt.description: Creation timestamp (ISO-8601). Defaults to the server time when omitted.

lastModified.description: Modification timestamp (ISO-8601). Defaults to the server time when omitted.

isAvailable.description: Whether the item is available for sale on the register immediately after creation.
